scope: S5 Tool broker lifecycle on an exclusive disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO fixture with an injected clock and declared adapter seam. It is not a Workspace service, protected sandbox, Firecracker, Linux/KVM, or EX-002 proof.

observations.least_privilege: An owner approval creates a one-use grant and the worker performs exactly one authorized adapter execution before the grant is exhausted.
observations.terminal_refusal: Injected-clock expiry, owner cancellation, policy denial, revocation, unavailable policy, and max-use exhaustion retain terminal durable state and do not dispatch an adapter operation.
observations.restart: A fresh PostgreSQL pool and reconstructed public runtime preserve the terminal grant and approval state; a late approval replay is rejected without issuing a second grant or dispatch.

redaction: No DSNs, object-store credentials, raw grants, operation IDs, descriptors, inputs, artifact bodies, or backend endpoints are retained.
